crosswalk_source: Author mapping (no official NIST mapping for this rule)
current_state: MFA, encryption, and EDR on IT; worker data copies on the hub (purged); shared crew logins
gap_description: Reasonable measures not yet in place for crew access and data copies
remediation_action: Data map; named crew accounts; purge controls

requirement_summary: Notify buyers within 24 hours of any event that could affect product safety, lot traceability, or committed volumes
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - about 60% of crop value goes to outside buyers
crosswalk_source: Author mapping (no official NIST mapping for this rule)
current_state: Sales staff call buyers informally; no buyer rows in the notification matrix
gap_description: Buyer clock not in the incident process (CF-019)
remediation_action: Buyer rows in the matrix (P08); contacts in the incident binder
owner: Crop Farming Director of Food Safety

requirement_summary: Food defense plan with vulnerability assessment, mitigation strategies, monitoring, corrective actions, verification, and training for registered food facilities
applies_at_this_tier: No - applies only to facilities required to register under FD&C Act 415 (121.1); farms are exempt from registration (21 CFR 1.226(b)); farm activities subject to the Produce Safety standards are also exempt (121.5(d)). Applies to the 11 Food Processing facilities (gap-analysis-food-processing.csv)
crosswalk_source: Author mapping (no official NIST mapping for this rule)
current_state: Not applicable to farm operations. Used as a voluntary checklist for fertigation tampering (CF-005)
remediation_action: Recheck if any farm begins manufacturing or processing for sale beyond farm activities
owner: Crop Farming Director of Food Safety

regulation: Records access, 21 CFR Part 1 Subpart J
requirement_summary: Establishment, maintenance, and availability of records for persons who manufacture, process, pack, transport, distribute, receive, hold, or import food
applies_at_this_tier: No - farms are excluded from all of Subpart J (1.327(a)). Food Processing holds the duty for lots it receives; Crop Farming harvest lot data supports it
crosswalk_source: Author mapping (no official NIST mapping for this rule)
current_state: Not applicable to farms; harvest lot data feeds Food Processing records (CF-010)
